recipe.visualDefinition: A classic cassette tape J-card design featuring a vertical spine with massive rotated text, a square photographic panel, and a large black footer area for secondary information and technical logos.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical spine text oriented 90 degrees counter-clockwise
High-contrast black footer against a colorful photographic top half
Tight, heavy sans-serif typography dominating the vertical and horizontal axes
Muted, grainy film photography with a soft, hazy atmosphere
coreInvariants: Split composition: 50% image, 50% solid black field
Ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif for primary titles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The primary subject is a dynamic figure in the foreground of the image panel, with a smaller secondary figure in the mid-ground, creating depth.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The massive vertical title on the spine acts as the primary structural anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the large vertical spine text, across to the image, and then down to the bold horizontal title in the black footer.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial negative space provided by the solid black lower half and the dark, textured spine background.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black serves as the foundation for the spine and footer.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for all typographic elements to ensure maximum legibility.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted purples and earthy tans within the photographic panel.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black backgrounds, paired with low-saturation, mid-value photographic tones.

characterSpecificRedesigns: Ampersand is simplified and condensed to match the width of the letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and scales to maintain 1970s utilitarian consistency.

preserve: Condensed nature of the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, high-impact feel of the primary title.
Provides the necessary vintage grotesque feel for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a split-screen layout. The top half is a grainy, 1970s-style film photograph of a woman in a flowing purple dress running in a field under a cloudy sky. The bottom half is a solid matte black rectangle. The left side features a vertical black strip for the spine.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, ultra-bold condensed sans-serif title in white. Rotate it 90 degrees counter-clockwise on the spine. Repeat the title horizontally at the top of the black footer. Add smaller technical metadata and tracklists in a medium-weight sans-serif in white.

verificationChecks: Is the spine text rotated correctly?
Is the primary font sufficiently bold and condensed?
Is the photographic panel grainy and desaturated?
Is the footer area solid black with white text?

postGenerationChecks: Check for 90-degree rotation on spine text.
Ensure white text is perfectly legible against black.
Confirm the photographic style looks like 35mm film.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a grainy action photograph with a bold, black-and-white typographic grid inspired by 1970s cassette packaging.
